### 1. User expression and simulator behaviour
Renata Quintero, closing tonight (scheduled closing 2026-10-14 = frozen date) via mobile notary; wants "the grant actually put toward your down payment before you sign ... take care of it today". Target object: the Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant on her loan file; action boundary: book the grant's down-payment application today; authorisation: she "authorise[s] the agent to book whatever the grant requires on your file today" and accepts closing-cost-first / lower-amount outcomes after a double-check. Simulator is passive: identity on request (phone 6145554127, DOB 1993-05-19), signs the owner-occupancy certification only when handed over, reads back its confirmation.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse
Act now. Visible grounds:
- Records: grant `1093c35f-...` program Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant, `status: reserved`, reserved 2026-09-24, expiration 2027-01-22, ledger empty ("No credit_ledger records"); loan file `9623848a-...` `status: clear_to_close`; Closing Disclosure `6846cb57-...` (`loan_cd_issued`, issued 2026-10-08, the only CD); closing `8b09f127-...` Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing, `scheduled_closing_date: 2026-10-14`.
- `grant_down_payment_application`: "On the day of the scheduled closing, while the loan file is clear to close and its Closing Disclosure has been issued, a verified Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant pays the down payment on that Closing Disclosure" — all hold today except "verified".
- `grant_occupancy_certification`: verified "when the borrower signs the twelve-month owner-occupancy certification within the program's verification deadline"; `reservation_and_verification_terms`: NAG verification deadline 30 calendar days after reservation → 2026-10-24 ≥ 2026-10-14, on time. Program tests (`program_eligibility_standard`, matrix, qualification tests): FHA 30-Year Fixed eligible; purchase; primary residence; single-family detached; score 664 ≥ 600; base 130275.00 ≤ 832750.00; value 135000.00 ≤ 850000.00; "tract or income" with tract `moderate` among "low, moderate" → passes.
- Expiry: "still valid on the expiration date itself"; expiration 2027-01-22, not passed.

### 3. Narrowest object / correlation keys
Customer `8cefef93-...`; loan file `9623848a-...`; grant `credit_award_id 1093c35f-26c4-424e-b96f-1ab20620cb64`; Closing Disclosure `6846cb57-9625-43f5-aa4f-d521fbf13d92` (the CD the loan closes on; LEs `89ae68ef`, `43826e33` and ITP `49e91478` excluded — "Only the latest Closing Disclosure issued on the file is read; an earlier disclosure, or a Loan Estimate, does not set the adjustment"); award entry = the entry booked by the certification (runtime id). Appraisal order `3f90614f-...` (fee entry 700.00 charged); loan fee ledger 92.40 credit report + 300.00 application; closing fee ledger 175.00 closing_method_fee + 75.00 after_hours_signing_fee, no reversals; lock `6a16f4c8-...` Larkspur 45-Day Rate Lock, one `lock_extension_booked` 265.11 `cost_bearer: borrower`, no waiver; no buydown, no conditions, no pre-approval, no deposits.

### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Certification `award_amount`.** Baseline (`grant_award_at_certification`): fixed credit amount 5000.00 lowered to cap 5000.00. Factors found from the loan file / CD:
- tract starting amount (`grant_tract_starting_amount`; record `census_tract_income_level: moderate`) → starting amount 4900.00;
- purchase-price adjustment (`property_value: 135000.0`, "150000.00 or less subtracts 250.00") → −250.00;
- household-income adjustment (`borrower_count: 1`) → +200.00;
- credit-score holdback (`credit_score: 664`, "from 640 through 679 ... 250.00") → −250.00;
- income phase-down (`qualifying_income_pct_ami: 86` → 6 points above 80 × 25.00) → −150.00;
- closing-cost burden (latest CD `total_closing_costs 7650.0` vs 4% of 135000.00 = 5400.00, above) → +250.00.
4900 − 250 + 200 − 250 − 150 + 250 = 4700.00; cap 5000.00 not reached; **4700.00**.
**(b) Closing-cost entry `entry_amount`.** Available balance 4700.00. Payable closing costs (`payable_charges_by_program_and_pricing`, FHA read first though `hpml_flag: True`) = zero-tolerance 3300.00 + 10% tolerance 1800.00 = 5100.00. Less concessions 2000.00 + 250.00; less charges paid before closing 700.00 + 300.00 + 92.40 = 1092.40; less closing-cost entries already booked 0.00; less closing-service exclusion (Mobile Notary: whole of 175.00 + 75.00 = 250.00); less rate-lock exclusion (45-Day lock: whole borrower-borne 265.11, none waived) → 5100 − 2250 − 1092.40 − 250 − 265.11 = 1242.49 (≥0). Closing-cost share (moderate tract) 90% → 1118.241 → 1118.24. Entry = lesser of 4700.00 and 1118.24 = **1118.24**.
**(c) Down-payment entry `entry_amount`.** Available balance 4700.00 − 1118.24 = 3581.76. Down payment = 135000.00 − 130275.00 = 4725.00. Reserve: own-funds floor (`qualifying_income_pct_ami 86` > 80) 2000.00 + repair reserve (appraisal `subject_to_completion: True`, FHA) 500.00 = 2500.00. Part kept in the down payment (FHA): borrower still pays nonrecurring 5600.00 − concessions 2250.00 − grant closing-cost entries 1118.24 = 2231.76; kept = 2500.00 − 2231.76 = 268.24. Amount = 4725.00 − 268.24 = 4456.76; base-LTV 130275/135000 = 96.50% > 95 → share 75% → 3342.57 → rounded down 3342.00 room. Entry = lesser of 3581.76 and 3342.00, less 0.00 earlier DP entries = **3342.00**.
Blind-stage reading note: the repair-reserve doc says it "adds a repair reserve ... to the reserve the borrower keeps in the down payment"; I read that phrase as the own-funds reserve itself (the baseline and own-funds-floor doc use the same phrase for the reserve: "The borrower keeps an own-funds reserve in the down payment", "own-funds floor of the reserve a borrower keeps in the down payment"), so it is added before the FHA offset. The alternative (add 500.00 after the offset: kept = 0 + 500 → room (4725 − 500) × 0.75 = 3168.75 → 3168.00) is the closest competing reading; the wording of the reserve-kept doc ("the part of the borrower's reserve kept in the down payment" vs "the reserve") favours mine. To be checked at reveal.

### 6. Problem tree (visible materials only)
Root: down-payment application of the grant (customer's ask).
- Hop 1 (DP → closing-cost entry), **state-derived**: `grant_down_payment_application`: "The down payment entry of a Neighborhood Access Grant is not fixed until its ledger carries the closing-cost entry for the Closing Disclosure the loan closes on." Record: grant ledger empty. Search "closing-cost entry" → `closing_cost_application_entry` ("For a Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant the closing-cost entry is one application entry naming that Closing Disclosure and the award entry it draws on"; tool books "one application entry for the nonrecurring closing costs category") and `grant_closing_cost_entry_amount` (its size). The reserve-kept FHA rule also reads "the grant's closing-cost entries", corroborating the order.
- Hop 2 (closing-cost entry → verification with award entry), **state-derived**: `closing_cost_application_entry`: "A Neighborhood Access Grant's closing-cost entry is booked only after the grant stands verified with an award entry on its ledger." Record: `status: reserved`, no ledger rows. Search "verified ... award entry" → `grant_occupancy_certification`: signing "moves the grant from reserved to verified ... books one award entry for that amount on the grant's ledger"; owner user.
- Order: certification (user) → closing-cost entry (agent) → down-payment entry (agent). No hop pre-solved: no document names another problem's tool beside a prerequisite sentence.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only the down payment": excluded by the hop-1 sentence (amount not fixed while no closing-cost entry) and by `application_at_closing_rules` cl.1 "A credit is applied at closing only while the credit status is verified" (grant is reserved).
- Closest alternative award 5000.00 (CD lender credit / schedule fixed amount): excluded by the factor docs found from the loan-file fields above; fall-back award = 5000.00.
- Fall-back numbers (computation docs + named schedule figures only): award 5000.00; closing-cost entry min(5000.00, 5600.00 − 2250.00 − 1092.40) = 2257.60; down-payment entry with reserve 1000.00: room 3725.00, balance 2742.40 → 2742.40. All definite, all differ from the blind answers.
- Factor findability: each factor was reached from record words — `census_tract_income_level`, `property_value`, `borrower_count`, `credit_score`, `qualifying_income_pct_ami`, CD `total_closing_costs`, `variant_name: Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed` (payable-charges, reserve-kept, repair), `variant_name: Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing` + fee codes, `variant_name: Larkspur 45-Day Rate Lock` + `lock_extension_booked`, appraisal `subject_to_completion`. No computation doc hints at a variation.
- Alternative CD/entry objects: only one CD; the LEs are excluded by the latest-CD rule.

contamination_disclosure: none. The brief contained no scored values.
